career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not complete replacement by AI, but AI drafting and templates reducing routine documentation while accuracy requirements rise. Information architecture and audience judgment become even scarcer.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, writers still decide how to organize information, assess audiences, and ensure accuracy. Their minds design, their hands write, and their shoulders bear responsibility. People cannot be fully removed from documentation.

responsibilities: Coordinate with engineering teams to clarify issues

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 整体取代，而是「AI 起草 + 模板」压低常规文档——有架构与把关力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI 整体取代，而是「AI 起草 + 模板」压低常规文档；同时准确性要求更高。信息架构与受众判断能力反而更稀缺。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，信息怎么组织、受众怎么判断、准确性怎么把关，最后还是写作者的脑去想、手去写、肩去扛——文档这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Specialized skill with a large talent gap
Highly remote-capable and readily augmented by AI

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risks in wind turbine maintenance are not AI but safety at height and life on site. AI cannot take the wrench out of your hand, but a single safety lapse can cost everything.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are not from AI but from work-at-height safety and weather windows. Towers dozens of meters high, energized equipment, and harsh offshore conditions make weak safety awareness potentially fatal. Remote locations, long periods away from home, and frequent site assignments also create real pressure.
risks: Work-at-height safety: high risk of falls and electrical hazards
Remote assignments far from home: extended time away and high living costs
Weather constraints: bad weather stops work and causes income volatility
Larger equipment: some tasks are physically demanding
Renewable energy volatility: policy and installation cycles affect hiring

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate which turbine is likely to fail, but climbing the tower and repairing it requires hands-on skill with a wrench—the human capability that underpins wind power and cannot be replaced by machines.

skills: Wind turbine mechanical and electrical maintenance
Work at height and safe operations
Work order and spare parts management

career_path_block.说明: 远程化程度高，易被 AI 强化

career_risk_cards.callout: 风电检修最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高空安全 + 驻场生活」——AI 撼动不了那一扳手，但安全上的一次疏忽，可能什么都没了。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高空作业安全 + 天气窗口」——几十米高的塔筒、带电设备、海上风场的恶劣环境，安全意识不到位就是性命攸关；同时工作地点偏、离家远、经常驻场，也是现实压力。
risks: 高空作业安全：坠落与带电风险高
驻场离家远：长期在外，生活成本高
天气制约：坏天气停工，收入波动
设备大型化：部分作业劳动强度大
新能源波动：政策与装机节奏影响用工

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出哪台风机快出毛病，但「爬上塔筒把毛病修好」——那一扳手的功夫，是机器替不了的风电底气。
